primitives.asks: Are the hard entry conditions met?

primitives.asks: Is a person already working this same blocker?

branches.label: Nobody on it
branches.test: no open case or owner covers it

primitives.state: deferred to the person already handling it
primitives.reEntry: if that case closes with the struggle unresolved, this qualifies again - two channels chasing one problem is worse than one slow channel
